summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on setting up a dedicated staging environment for analytics processing. It was decided that the staging database will be named `allunite_stage` (or `allunite_STAGE`) to keep it concise and easily identifiable.

Regarding data pipelines, there is an agreement to move the entire recalculation cycle into Windmill for staging purposes. The user confirmed they are working on creating the necessary databases in ClickHouse (`allunite_stage`) and will aim to provide a version suitable for testing by Monday. A separate database setup for PostgreSQL was not guaranteed but effort would be made.

Testing methods were briefly discussed, suggesting that raw data could be loaded into the staging environment.
decisions: The staging database name will be `allunite_stage` (or `allunite_STAGE`).
The full recalculation cycle should be implemented in Windmill for staging.
action_items: User to provide ClickHouse setup scripts for `allunite_stage`.
User to work on the PostgreSQL database setup and aim to deliver it by Monday.
